note: This problem exists as a folklore open question with no attributed year of first posing. The Wikipedia article 'List of unsolved problems in mathematics' includes it without citation or footnote in the Model theory and formal languages section. The problem descends from the Ax-Kochen-Ershov tradition (initiated 1966) but was never formally posed with an attributed researcher or date. Two sub-questions are posed: (1) Is the elementary theory of Z_p((t)) (Laurent series over p-adic integers) decidable? (2) Is the elementary theory of the field of polynomials over C decidable? Both remain completely open as of September 2026.
